issues.description: The problem statement specifies construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(...) -> stim.Circuit (it should return a Stim circuit), but the template's function signature annotates the return type as None. This mismatch between the declared return type in the template and the specification will confuse students (and static type checkers) about what to implement and return.
